See visual-kit/audio-tokens.json for pools + dials. NOTE for orchestrator: two variant-selection dependencies that audio-plan.json cannot express (mood-only) are flagged in exec-audio-replan.md §Blockers (upbeat pool must resolve to Fig Leaf, not Monkeys; boom should be added to consistent_sfx so all four stamp-slams are the same variant).
